discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field that has long been a leading Nobel candidate. It pairs a clean theory prediction (Kane-Mele Z2 quantum spin Hall effect) with a decisive experimental confirmation (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells), the kind of theory-plus-experiment story the committee likes. It also has a three-person citation that fits the rules, and it builds on the 2016 prize for topological phases.
